note: The official questions and answers for rules 1 to 21, in the project's own words (FR-07, FR-22). Each names the rule it refers to and says whether the code models it. A ruling with modeled false waits for the tier named in status.

rulings.summary: Portage cost is paid for every weapon carried at any point of the move. A squad that carries 2 points, drops them, and picks up 2 more has paid 4 points for the phase.
rulings.status: portage_max tracks the largest load of the phase; the movement allowance uses the sum of loads carried during the phase

rulings.summary: Until rule 57 is used, units in a multi-story building are on both levels at the same time. Two attacks in one phase may treat the same units as upper level and as lower level.
rulings.status: the evaluator uses the upper level for LOS; the per-attack choice waits for rule 17 penetration options in v0.3

rulings.summary: A squad that used its inherent firepower in the Prep Fire Phase may not fire a support weapon in the Advancing Fire Phase.
rulings.status: the prep_fired flag stops the squad and its weapons in the Advancing Fire Phase

rulings.summary: Passengers on adjacent halftracks may form multi-hex fire groups.
rulings.status: vehicles, Scale

rulings.summary: Terrain effects modifiers are cumulative. A halftrack passenger does not add the wall modifier to the halftrack's own protection.
rulings.status: cumulative modifiers in v0.1; the halftrack part is Scale

rulings.summary: The building modifier applies to fire at adjacent units in the same building.
rulings.status: the target hex terrain modifier applies to every attack

rulings.summary: When the center unit of a three-hex chain fires separately, the two end units cannot form a fire group.
rulings.status: a fire group must be a connected chain of adjacent hexes

rulings.summary: Each leader that breaks in a hex causes one more normal morale check for the other units. With two broken leaders a squad takes the fire table check plus two normal checks.
rulings.status: the second check is applied once for each leader that breaks

rulings.summary: A routing unit may rout toward an enemy position that is out of its own LOS, even when other friendly units see that position.
rulings.status: known enemy positions are the unbroken enemy units with a LOS to the broken unit's hex at the start of its rout

rulings.summary: A broken unit in the LOS of an enemy unit may not move closer to it, even when the move takes it out of that LOS.
rulings.status: the range to each known enemy may not decrease at any step

rulings.summary: Concealed units are not known enemy positions while they stay concealed.
rulings.status: concealment, v0.3

rulings.summary: A smoke hex, a vehicle, a wreck, an entrenchment, a bunker, or a roadblock changes open ground for the rout route in the same way as a wall or hedge.
rulings.status: smoke in v0.3, the others in Scale

rulings.summary: A routing unit may rout through a full cover hex but not into it. Routed units over the stacking limit are eliminated. Broken units over the limit from a track return survive until the end of the next Rout Phase.
rulings.status: cover hexes over the limit are not destinations; over-limit broken units after a return are eliminated at the end of the Rout Phase

rulings.summary: Desperation morale applies to the fire that broke the unit when that fire came since the preceding Rally Phase.
rulings.status: the dm flag is set on every unit in a hex that is fired on

rulings.summary: A player may leave a leader's rating out of a fire group. A poor leader's +1 cannot be refused for morale checks and rally attempts.
rulings.status: group_leader is a command; morale checks and rallies use the best leader in the hex, which includes a +1 leader when no other leader is present

rulings.summary: A multi-hex fire group may use a leadership modifier when each hex of the chain holds a leader, and the modifier is the least effective of those leaders.
rulings.status: group_leader with a multi-hex group requires a leader in each member hex and uses the weakest rating

rulings.summary: Infantry that debarks into an adjacent hex may be fired on in the hex it left, with the vehicle modifier and the open ground modifier where they apply.
rulings.status: vehicles, Scale

rulings.summary: Shellholes, wheatfields, and hedges do not stop penetration. Walls stop it when the wall is on the same level as the firer and the target.
rulings.status: a wall hexside on the LOS ends the penetration walk

rulings.summary: The same machine gun attacks a unit only once in a phase, even when the unit keeps moving along its LOS.
rulings.status: a unit is in one target hex for each fire group

rulings.summary: A LOS along the hexside of a single smoke hex is not affected, except that penetrating fire through the smoke side is. The firer may trace through the other side.
rulings.status: smoke, v0.3

rulings.summary: One dice roll tests breakdown for all weapons in the fire group, and each weapon uses its own breakdown number.
rulings.status: each weapon in the group compares the unmodified roll with its own number

rulings.summary: A berserk unit may carry only the portage that does not reduce its movement: three points for a squad, one for a leader.
rulings.status: berserk units drop weapons above the free portage
